end.parentNote: Asha practised shared responsibility for a clean, green, and safe school, along with wet/dry waste sorting and composting. Anika explained that everyone can help keep the school clean and that wet waste such as fruit peels goes in the green bin. Anika continued to include plastic and foil in compost, so this mix-up was not corrected by the end of the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, sort a few household items together into wet waste, dry waste, and “not for compost,” explaining that plastic does not rot into soil.
